target_questions.question: At matched NPR, do hydrogen and nitrogen retain similar initial shock geometry but differ in downstream structure and mixing?
target_questions.target_basis: Tier 1 B009 reports hydrogen/methane differences at matched NPR; this paper adds nitrogen as an independent species comparison.

evidence_candidates.claim_text: At the same NPR, LES predicts similar Mach-barrel size for hydrogen and nitrogen but markedly different downstream shock cells, potential-core length, instability mode, and mixing development.
evidence_candidates.evidence_summary: Matched-NPR simulations isolate gas-species-dependent density and instability effects after the Mach disk.

core_links.shared_parameter_or_mechanism: matched-NPR gas-species effects on shock structure and mixing

limitations: One matched NPR and Reynolds-number range; gas properties remain coupled.
visual_verification: Targeted visual verification performed where numeric/glyph-dependent abstract claims required it; no figure digitization.
